request.system:
你是外贸工厂的"询盘分析员"。读一条买家询盘，把买家要什么、和工厂能给什么之间的差距找出来，给业务员看。

规则：
- 只根据询盘原文和给你的工厂/产品资料判断，不猜测、不补充外部信息。
- 每一条 requests、signals、conflicts 都必须带 `quote`：从询盘原文里逐字复制的一小段（不超过 20 个词），证明这条判断有出处。找不到原文依据的条目不要写。
- conflicts 只写买家要求和工厂资料确实对不上的地方（认证、付款、交期、运输方式、价格、数量、材料宣称等）。
- 所有说明用简体中文。

只输出 JSON，结构如下：
{
  "buyer": {"country_guess": "...", "language": "en|es|...", "business_type_zh": "...", "sales_channel_zh": "..."},
  "requests": [{"topic_zh": "数量|价格条款|认证|付款|交期|包装|样品|其他", "value": "...", "quote": "..."}],
  "signals": [{"signal_zh": "询盘质量信号，例如：给出具体数量、说明销售渠道、使用公司邮箱", "positive": true, "quote": "..."}],
  "conflicts": [{"topic_zh": "...", "buyer_wants": "...", "factory_can": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "quote": "..."}],
  "summary_zh": "一句话：这个买家是谁、值不值得优先跟进、最大的风险是什么"
}

messages.content:
## 询盘原文
Hello, I manage procurement for a 40-property hotel group in Florida. We plan to place one garment steamer in each guest room, about 3,200 units in total, delivered in two lots in Q1. Please quote FOB Ningbo by sea for 3,000+ units, and confirm whether the unit has ETL or UL. We normally pay by L/C at sight. Could you also send 2 samples to our Orlando office? Regards, Dana Whitfield, Procurement Manager

## 工厂与产品资料
{
 "factory": {
  "name_zh": "甬江小家电（示例工厂）",
  "name_en": "Yongjiang Small Appliances (demo factory)",
  "city": "Ningbo",
  "port": "Ningbo-Zhoushan",
  "capacity_units_per_month": 20000,
  "standard_lead_time_days": 35,
  "payment_terms_accepted": [
   "30% T/T deposit, 70% against B/L copy",
   "L/C at sight"
  ],
  "sales_contact_role": "业务员",
  "services": [
   "可寄样：样品按出厂单价收费，国际运费由买家承担；量产订单可抵扣样品费",
   "可安排视频验厂（阿里国际站视频通话）",
   "彩盒可印买家 logo：1000 个以上免费，以下每个加收 USD 0.15，需买家提供矢量稿"
  ]
 },
 "product": {
  "id": "GS-12H",
  "name_zh": "手持挂烫机",
  "name_en": "Handheld Garment Steamer",
  "specs": {
   "water_tank_ml": 260,
   "power_w_us": 1200,
   "voltage_us": "120V 60Hz",
   "heat_up_s": "约 25 秒（工厂内部测试）",
   "features": [
    "vertical and horizontal steaming",
    "detachable water tank",
    "auto shut-off",
    "fabric brush included"
   ]
  },
  "certifications_held": [
   "CB report (IEC 60335-2-3)",
   "CE (LVD/EMC)"
  ],
  "certifications_not_held": [
   "UL",
   "ETL",
   "NOM"
  ],
  "material_tests": {},
  "moq_units": 800,
  "fob_ningbo_usd": {
   "800-2999": 11.6,
   "3000+": 10.9
  },
  "packaging": "color box, 12 units per carton",
  "selling_points_zh": [
   "约 25 秒出蒸汽（工厂内部测试）",
   "可竖挂可平烫",
   "水箱可拆，好加水",
   "附带刷头"
  ]
 }
}
